faq.a: Mesud is associated with the Arabic form مَسْعُود, whose core sense is mesud; fortunate, happy (balkan form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Mesud?
faq.a: Mesud is associated with Arabic. Mesud is the Bosnian form of Arabic مَسْعُود (Masʿūd), meaning 'fortunate, happy'.
Yes — the underlying form مَسْعُود is Arabic.
Mesud can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Mesud should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Masʿūd is not a Quranic personal name.
